input.quote: 16.5 Disclaimer of Liability for Consequential Damages. UNLESS EXPRESSLY PROVIDED HEREUNDER, IN NO EVENT SHALL EITHER PARTY OR ANY OF ITS RESPECTIVE AFFILIATES AND THEIR RESPECTIVE OFFICERS, DIRECTORS AND EMPLOYEES BE LIABLE UNDER THIS AGREEMENT FOR SPECIAL, INDIRECT, PUNITIVE, INCIDENTAL OR CONSEQUENTIAL DAMAGES SUFFERED BY THE OTHER PARTY UNDER THIS AGREEMENT
input.rationale: Section 16.5 is the only liability-limiting provision in the Agreement. It is mutual and correctly excludes indirect/consequential damages, and it carves out the third-party indemnities under Sections 16.1/16.2 and gross negligence/willful misconduct — but it contains no aggregate monetary cap, and searches for "aggregate liability", "limitation of liability" and "shall not exceed" confirm no cap appears anywhere else (Articles XV, XVI, XVII and XVIII). Both Parties' direct liability is therefore unlimited, which fails the fallback requirement of a mutual cap of 12 months' fees on a material term. We propose inserting a mutual cap at the greater of 12 months' payments by Ono and USD 1,000,000, with confidentiality (Article 10), indemnification (Sections 16.1–16.2), gross negligence, willful misconduct, fraud and IP infringement expressly outside the cap, plus confirmation that Ono's payment obligations are not "damages". Note the cap is symmetrical, so this is not walk-away territory (neither party is one-sidedly capped); it is a gap rather than an adverse asymmetry.

proposal.summary: Add a mutual aggregate liability cap with standard carve-outs to Section 16.5
proposal.comment: [Playbook] Section 16.5 waives consequential damages but sets no aggregate cap, so both Parties' direct liability is unlimited. We have added a mutual cap at the greater of 12 months' payments and USD 1,000,000, with confidentiality, indemnification, gross negligence, willful misconduct, fraud and IP infringement sitting outside the cap, and confirming that Ono's payment obligations are not "damages" for cap purposes.

ops.text: Except for Excluded Claims, each Party's total aggregate liability arising out of or relating to this Agreement shall not exceed the greater of (a) the aggregate amounts paid or payable by Ono to Array under this Agreement in the twelve (12) months immediately preceding the event giving rise to the claim and (b) USD 1,000,000. "Excluded Claims" means a Party's breach of its confidentiality obligations under Article 10, its indemnification obligations under Sections 16.1 and 16.2, its gross negligence, willful misconduct or fraud, and its infringement of the other Party's intellectual property rights. Amounts payable by Ono under this Agreement shall not constitute damages for purposes of this cap.
